ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: For a period of 12 months after the end of any person's involvement, neither party shall solicit or allow its respective affiliates to solicit any person who was an employee of the other party and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.

ops.text: This restriction is mutual and binds each party equally, and does not apply to general advertisements or to unsolicited approaches by any such person.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the no-hire and the Agreement-term limb so the covenant is expressly mutual and runs only for 12 months after the end of a person's involvement, covering only personnel directly involved in the services, and we added the general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. This is our fallback position on employee non-solicitation.
proposal.summary: Narrow Section 19 to an expressly mutual 12-month non-solicit keyed to the end of each person's involvement in the services, delete the no-hire, and add general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
